description: Feature test plan for Editio markdown typesetting. Used for iterative development and regression tracking. Each step requires image validation: PDF → PNG, then vision evaluation of rendering.
validationWorkflow: For each test: 1) Compile fixture to PDF. 2) Convert PDF to PNG (e.g. pdftoppm -png or ImageMagick). 3) Use vision to evaluate PNG against expectedRendering. If the feature does not render correctly, the step remains incomplete and undergoes iterative troubleshoot-recode-recompile-vision/test until it passes.

tests.testName: Minimal document produces non-blank PDF
tests.assessment: Verify end-to-end pipeline: parse → AST → layout → PDF. Ensure at least title or one paragraph is rendered. Check printpdf integration and coordinate system.

validation.expectedRendering: Page shows heading 'Minimal Document' and at least one line of body text ('A single paragraph...'). Page is not blank.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms visible heading and paragraph text; page is non-blank.

tests.testName: Plain paragraph text renders to PDF
tests.assessment: Single and multiple paragraphs; confirm font, size, and line breaks. Baseline for text renderer.

validation.expectedRendering: Heading 'Paragraphs' plus three distinct paragraphs of text, with clear line breaks between them.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms multiple paragraphs are visible and separated.

tests.testName: Headings (h1–h6) render with correct hierarchy
tests.assessment: Size/weight differentiation; optional numbering. Feed into section formatting.

validation.expectedRendering: Six heading levels (Heading 1 through Heading 6) with visibly decreasing size or distinct hierarchy; body text 'Body after headings.'
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms h1–h6 hierarchy and size differentiation.

tests.testName: CommonMark inline: bold, italic, code, links
tests.assessment: Ensure pulldown-cmark events map to AST Inline types and PDF draws correctly.

validation.expectedRendering: Text shows bold, italic, code (monospace/Courier), and link text (blue or distinct); mixed and nested formatting (e.g. bold+italic) in one line. Words have normal single-character spacing. Inline code: content only, no backtick characters shown. Links: blue text (clickable PDF link optional).
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms: (1) bold, italic, and bold+italic (nested) are distinct; (2) code in monospace; (3) link text visually distinct (e.g. blue); (4) word spacing normal, no overlap or gappy spacing.

tests.testName: CommonMark blocks: lists (ordered, unordered), blockquote
tests.assessment: List indentation and markers; blockquote styling. Critical for figure wrap with lists (PRD differentiator).

validation.expectedRendering: Unordered list with bullets/dashes; ordered list with 1. 2.; blockquote with distinct styling (indent or prefix).
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms lists and blockquote are visually distinct from body text.

tests.testName: GFM extensions: strikethrough, task lists, autolinks
tests.assessment: If GFM is in scope; otherwise mark as N/A or low priority.

validation.expectedRendering: Table with A/B and 1/2; task list items (unchecked/checked if supported); strikethrough on 'deleted' if supported.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms table and any GFM features render as intended.

tests.testName: Standard markdown table renders with grid
tests.assessment: Header row, borders, alignment. Table parser + editio-pdf table_renderer.

validation.expectedRendering: Heading 'Table Basic'; table with header row Col1, Col2, Col3 and data rows A/B/C, D/E/F in aligned columns.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms table structure with header and rows clearly laid out.

tests.testName: Table with caption and label for cross-reference
tests.assessment: Caption text, numbering (Table N), label for [@tbl:label]. Integrate with label_registry.

validation.expectedRendering: Caption like 'Table: Sample data' or 'Table 1'; table with X/Y and 1/2.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms caption and table present.

tests.testName: Table column alignment (left, center, right)
tests.assessment: Alignment from markdown or attributes; pass through to PDF layout.

validation.expectedRendering: Table with Left, Center, Right columns and aligned cell content.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms column alignment is applied or table is readable.

tests.testName: Image with caption and optional label
tests.assessment: ![caption](path){label=fig:x}. Placeholder or real image; caption and numbering.

validation.expectedRendering: Image (or placeholder/alt) with caption text below; optional 'Figure 1' or label.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms figure and caption (or clear placeholder) are present.

tests.testName: Float attributes: float=right, width=50%
tests.assessment: YAML-style attributes; layout engine must produce wrap zones. Core differentiator.

validation.expectedRendering: Figure positioned (e.g. right side); text before and after; no overlap.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms float positioning or figure and text both visible without overlap.

tests.testName: Text wrapping around floated figure
tests.assessment: Two-pass layout: wrap zones, text flow around float. Avoid overlap.

validation.expectedRendering: Text flows around figure (wrap); no overlapping text and image.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms text wrap around figure or no overlap.

tests.testName: List wrapping around floated figure
tests.assessment: PRD key differentiator. Lists + floats; list_wrap and float_collector integration.

validation.expectedRendering: List items and figure both visible; list wraps or coexists with figure without overlap.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms list and figure both present and layout is correct.

tests.testName: YAML front matter parses (title, author, date)
tests.assessment: editio-parser front_matter; DocumentMetadata; no invalid YAML crash.

validation.expectedRendering: Document body shows 'Document' heading and 'Content after valid YAML front matter.' (metadata may appear in header/footer if implemented).
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms body content rendered; no crash; metadata applied if visible.

tests.testName: Page settings in front matter (margins, page size, font size)
tests.assessment: Dimension parsing (mm, in, pt); apply in layout and PDF. A4 vs letter.

validation.expectedRendering: Page has visible margins (content not at edge); page size consistent (A4); heading 'Page' and body text.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms margins and page layout reflect front matter settings.

tests.testName: Invalid YAML front matter fails with clear error
tests.assessment: Error message with line/context; no panic. Edge case from PRD.

steps: expect non-zero exit and stderr message containing 'YAML' or 'invalid'
validation.expectedRendering: N/A – CLI must exit non-zero with clear error message; no PDF produced.
validation.passCriteria: Compile fails with clear error; no panic.

tests.testName: Cross-reference to figure [@fig:label]
tests.assessment: Resolve label to number; render 'Figure 1' or similar. editio-ast cross_ref_parser.

validation.expectedRendering: Text 'See Figure 1 for details' (or 'Figure 1' resolved); figure with label/caption; caption text.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms cross-ref resolves to 'Figure 1' (or equivalent), not raw [@fig:sample].

tests.testName: Cross-reference to table and section
tests.assessment: Unified label registry; section numbering (1, 1.1).

validation.expectedRendering: References resolved to 'Table 1' and 'Section 1.1' or similar; table and section heading visible.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms table/section refs resolved to numbers, not raw @tbl:/@sec:.

tests.testName: Inline math $E=mc^2$ and display math $$...$$
tests.assessment: Math preprocessor; AST Math nodes; pdflatex path or placeholder.

validation.expectedRendering: Inline formula E=mc^2 visible in line; display formula (integral) on its own line or block.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms math notation is rendered (as text or typeset), not raw $...$.

tests.testName: Math with label for equation numbering
tests.assessment: Label parsing; equation numbering; cross-ref to equation.

validation.expectedRendering: Display equation (sum formula) with number (e.g. (1)); text 'Refer to equation 1' or similar.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms equation number and reference resolved.

tests.testName: Theorem and proof block directives
tests.assessment: :::{theorem}{label=thm:1}...:::; numbering and optional styling.

validation.expectedRendering: Theorem block with 'Pythagoras' and formula a²+b²=c²; Proof block with 'Clear from geometry.'
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms theorem and proof blocks are visually distinct and content correct.

tests.testName: Algorithm block with caption
tests.assessment: :::{algorithm}{caption=...}...:::; algorithm_renderer.

validation.expectedRendering: Algorithm caption (e.g. Euclid(a,b)); numbered steps with math (While b≠0...).
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms algorithm block and steps are present and readable.

tests.testName: Code block with caption and label
tests.assessment: code_renderer; listing numbering; cross-ref.

validation.expectedRendering: Code block with Rust code (fn main, println!); monospace or distinct font; optional caption/label.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms code block is visible and code is readable.

tests.testName: Citation [@key] and bibliography resolution
tests.assessment: editio-bib parser; citation_renderer; author-year or numeric.

validation.expectedRendering: Citations rendered as [Smith 2020] or [1] etc., not raw [@smith2020]; optional bibliography section.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms citations are resolved to author-year or numbers, not raw keys.

tests.testName: editio compile -i <input> -o <output> produces file
tests.assessment: CLI parsing; output path; file exists and non-zero size.

steps: optional: export to PNG and vision-check non-blank
validation.expectedRendering: PDF file created and non-blank (vision-check first page if using image validation).
validation.passCriteria: Output file exists, non-zero size, and first page is non-blank (if PNG checked).

tests.testName: editio check <file> validates without writing output
tests.assessment: Exit 0 for valid; non-zero and message for invalid.

steps: run check -i invalid-syntax.md → exit non-zero with message
validation.expectedRendering: N/A. Valid file exits 0; invalid file exits 1 with clear stderr.
validation.passCriteria: Both exit codes and messages match expectations.

tests.testName: Page margins and size applied
tests.assessment: Visual or programmatic check; margins in layout engine.

validation.expectedRendering: Content inset from page edges (margins); page proportions match A4; no content at trim edge.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms margins and page size are visibly applied.

tests.testName: Headers and footers with page number
tests.assessment: header_footer module; title/author in header; page N in footer.

validation.expectedRendering: Running header (e.g. 'Editio Test'); footer with 'Page 1 of 1' or similar.
validation.passCriteria: Vision confirms header and footer text visible on the page.

tests.testName: Empty document or only front matter
tests.assessment: No panic; blank or single page with metadata only.

validation.expectedRendering: Empty page or single page with no body content (no crash).
validation.passCriteria: Compile succeeds; PNG shows blank page or minimal page without error.

tests.testName: Missing image file reports clear error
tests.assessment: Error with path and suggestion; continue or fail consistently.

steps: run compile; either exit non-zero with clear error, or produce PDF with placeholder/error note
if PDF produced, export to PNG and vision-check
validation.expectedRendering: Either CLI error mentioning missing file, or PDF with placeholder/caption and no crash.
validation.passCriteria: No panic; either clear error or graceful degradation (placeholder).
